column8: All declared tests in this source file are mapped between the leaf vectors and the canonical Datum state plus shared aggregate runtime route. Descriptor-driven EvalInt coercion, typed chunk lifecycle, and executor memory tracking remain open.

Source 0..4 AND/OR/XOR vectors, operation identities, NULL skipping, signed raw-bit and unsigned inputs, same-operation partial merge, reset, exact UInt output, fallible domain rejection, XOR departure-before-arrival behavior, and all three shared-runtime dispatch arms are covered through the one canonical state. Go descriptor-driven EvalInt and chunk execution remain open.

The source-shaped partial value and spill payload are exactly one 8-byte uint64 for all three operations and reset/update/merge allocate no variable payload. The Rust runtime wrapper also carries its operation kind; Go PartialResult allocation deltas and the executor memory tracker remain open.

The exact source vectors 0, 1, and 2 plus MaxUint64 serialize to one host-native 8-byte payload and deserialize through the canonical state. Short input is rejected safely, while a trailing byte is accepted after consuming the first uint64, matching the Go helper's cursor-shaped same-host spill contract.
